verifications.claim: President Donald Trump fired Pam Bondi from her position as U.S. Attorney General on April 2, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Trump fires Attorney General Pam Bondi' (dated 2026/04/02); R2: 'President Trump fired Attorney General Pam Bondi on Thursday, April 2, 2026'; R3: 'fired her via social media post' on April 2, 2026; R4: 'Trump has announced that Pam Bondi is out as US attorney general' on Thursday (April 2, 2026 context).
verifications.reasoning: All references directly confirm the firing of Pam Bondi as U.S. Attorney General by Trump on April 2, 2026.
